verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec for Fastmail, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The JMAP `/.well-known/jmap` session object is a machine-readable capability and URL discovery document, not a schema or spec of the API's methods and types. The JMAP standard being 'fully documented' refers to human-readable documentation, so both are adjacent features that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
